characters.name: Mary
characters.title: Mother of Jesus
characters.bio: The virgin of Nazareth who answered the angel, 'Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word.' She pondered shepherds' words in her heart, and stood at the foot of the cross.

characters.name: Joseph
characters.title: Carpenter & Guardian of the Child
characters.bio: A just man of David's line who was minded to put Mary away privily — until an angel spoke in his dreams. He named the child Jesus, and dreams guided him again to Egypt and home to Nazareth.

characters.name: John the Baptist
characters.title: Voice in the Wilderness
characters.bio: The forerunner in camel's hair who cried 'Prepare ye the way of the Lord' and pointed his own disciples away from himself: 'Behold the Lamb of God.' He baptized the Savior in Jordan and said, 'He must increase, but I must decrease.'

characters.name: Elisabeth
characters.title: Mother of the Forerunner
characters.bio: Righteous and barren until old age, she conceived the Baptist by promise. When Mary's greeting reached her ears the babe leaped in her womb, and she cried, 'Blessed art thou among women.'

characters.name: Simeon & Anna
characters.title: Watchers at the Temple
characters.bio: Two aged saints who recognized the infant Lord at His presentation — Simeon, promised he would not die before seeing the Christ, sang 'Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace,' and Anna the prophetess, who departed not from the temple, spake of him to all that looked for redemption.

characters.name: Peter
characters.title: Chief Apostle, the Rock
characters.bio: The Galilean fisherman who left his nets, walked on water until he doubted, and answered the great question: 'Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.' He wept bitterly at his denial — then fed the Lord's sheep to a martyr's death.

characters.name: Andrew
characters.title: First-Called Fisherman
characters.bio: A disciple of the Baptist who followed Jesus first and straightway 'findeth his own brother Simon' — the apostle who kept bringing people to Christ, including the lad with five loaves and two fishes.

characters.name: James
characters.title: Son of Zebedee, Son of Thunder
characters.bio: Fisherman brother of John, one of the three at the mount of Transfiguration and in Gethsemane. He drank the cup he had asked for — the first of the Twelve to be martyred, by Herod's sword.

characters.name: John the Beloved
characters.title: Apostle, Revelator, the Disciple Jesus Loved
characters.bio: The fisherman who leaned on the Lord's breast at supper, received Mary as his own mother from the cross, and outran Peter to the empty tomb. Apostle of love — 'God is love' — and seer of Patmos, who asked to tarry until the Lord comes.

characters.name: Matthew
characters.title: Publican Turned Evangelist
characters.bio: A tax collector sitting at the receipt of custom when Jesus said 'Follow me' — and he arose, left all, and made the Lord a great feast among his fellow publicans. His Gospel proclaims Jesus as the promised King of the Jews.

characters.name: Thomas
characters.title: The Twin Who Touched and Believed
characters.bio: The apostle who said 'Let us also go, that we may die with him,' yet would not believe the resurrection without seeing the print of the nails. Eight days later he answered the risen Lord with the great confession: 'My Lord and my God.'

characters.name: Philip
characters.title: Apostle of Bethsaida
characters.bio: Found by Jesus the day after Peter, he immediately found Nathanael: 'Come and see.' At the last supper he asked, 'Lord, shew us the Father,' and received the answer: 'he that hath seen me hath seen the Father.'

characters.name: Judas Iscariot
characters.title: The Betrayer
characters.bio: Keeper of the bag who sold his Master for thirty pieces of silver and marked Him with a kiss in Gethsemane. He cast the silver down in the temple — 'I have betrayed the innocent blood' — and went out and hanged himself.

characters.name: Mary Magdalene
characters.title: First Witness of the Resurrection
characters.bio: Delivered of seven devils, she followed and ministered to the Lord, stood by the cross, and came to the garden tomb while it was yet dark. The risen Christ spoke her name — 'Mary' — and she answered, 'Rabboni,' the first mortal to see Him alive.

characters.name: Martha
characters.title: Hostess of Bethany
characters.bio: Cumbered about much serving while her sister sat at the Lord's feet, she still bore one of the Gospels' plainest testimonies at her brother's tomb: 'Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.'

characters.name: Lazarus
characters.title: The Man Called Out of the Tomb
characters.bio: The friend of Bethany whom Jesus loved and wept for. Four days dead, he came forth bound hand and foot at the words 'Lazarus, come forth' — a living witness the chief priests then consulted to put to death.

characters.name: Nicodemus
characters.title: Pharisee Who Came by Night
characters.bio: A ruler of the Jews who sought Jesus in darkness and heard that a man must be 'born again' to see the kingdom of God. He defended the Lord in council, and at the end brought a hundred pounds of myrrh and aloes to His burial.

characters.name: Zacchaeus
characters.title: Publican in the Sycamore Tree
characters.bio: The chief publican of Jericho, little of stature, who climbed a sycamore to see Jesus pass — and heard Him call his name and come to his house. 'Half of my goods I give to the poor,' he vowed, and salvation came to his house that day.

characters.name: Pontius Pilate
characters.title: Roman Governor of Judaea
characters.bio: The prefect who found no fault in Jesus, asked 'What is truth?', and delivered Him to be crucified anyway — washing his hands before the multitude. His superscription stood over the cross: 'JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.'

characters.name: Herod
characters.title: The Dynasty of Fear
characters.bio: The name of a jealous royal house — Herod the Great, who slew the infants of Bethlehem to kill one child, and his son Antipas, who beheaded John for a dancing girl's request and arrayed Jesus in a gorgeous robe of mockery.

characters.name: Caiaphas
characters.title: High Priest Who Condemned the Lord
characters.bio: President of the council who prophesied better than he knew — 'it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people' — and rent his clothes at the Savior's own witness, crying 'He hath spoken blasphemy.'

characters.name: Stephen
characters.title: First Martyr of the Church
characters.bio: One of the seven, full of faith and power, whose face shone like an angel's before the council. Stoned outside the city, he looked up steadfastly and saw 'the Son of man standing on the right hand of God' — and prayed, 'lay not this sin to their charge.'

characters.name: Philip the Evangelist
characters.title: Preacher to Samaria & the Desert Road
characters.bio: One of the seven who carried the word down to Samaria, then ran to a chariot on the Gaza road: 'Understandest thou what thou readest?' He opened Isaiah to the Ethiopian treasurer and baptized him in the desert water.

characters.name: Cornelius
characters.title: Centurion, First Gentile Convert
characters.bio: A devout centurion of the Italian band whose prayers and alms 'came up for a memorial before God.' An angel sent him to Peter, the Spirit fell on his household, and the door of the gospel opened to all nations.

characters.name: Barnabas
characters.title: Son of Consolation
characters.bio: The Levite of Cyprus who sold his land and laid the money at the apostles' feet — and who took the feared convert Saul by the hand and vouched for him when all Jerusalem trembled. 'He was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith.'

characters.name: Paul
characters.title: Apostle to the Gentiles
characters.bio: Saul the persecutor, struck down on the Damascus road — 'Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?' — became the tireless apostle whose journeys and epistles carried the gospel across the empire. From a Roman prison he wrote his epitaph: 'I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith.'

characters.name: Silas
characters.title: Fellow Prisoner Who Sang at Midnight
characters.bio: A chief man among the brethren, chosen by Paul for the second journey. Beaten and stocked in the Philippian jail, he prayed and sang praises at midnight with Paul — until the earthquake opened every door.

characters.name: Timothy
characters.title: Paul's Son in the Faith
characters.bio: Raised on scripture by his grandmother Lois and mother Eunice, he became Paul's most trusted companion and the young bishop of Ephesus. 'Let no man despise thy youth,' Paul charged him, 'but be thou an example of the believers.'

characters.name: Lydia
characters.title: Seller of Purple, First European Convert
characters.bio: A businesswoman of Thyatira, worshipping by the riverside at Philippi, 'whose heart the Lord opened.' Baptized with her household, she constrained the missionaries: 'come into my house, and abide there.'

characters.name: Aquila & Priscilla
characters.title: Tentmakers of the Way
characters.bio: A husband-and-wife team of tentmakers who worked, traveled, and hosted congregations with Paul — and together 'expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly' to the eloquent Apollos. Paul wrote that they had 'for my life laid down their own necks.'

characters.name: Apollos
characters.title: Eloquent & Mighty in the Scriptures
characters.bio: An Alexandrian Jew, fervent in spirit but knowing only John's baptism, until Aquila and Priscilla taught him more perfectly. He mightily convinced the Jews at Corinth — where Paul summed up their partnership: 'I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.'

characters.name: Mark
characters.title: Evangelist of the Servant Lord
characters.bio: John Mark of Jerusalem, who turned back from the first journey and split Paul from Barnabas — yet was fully reclaimed: 'he is profitable to me for the ministry,' Paul wrote at the last. His swift, vivid Gospel preserves Peter's eyewitness voice.

characters.name: Luke
characters.title: The Beloved Physician
characters.bio: Paul's Gentile companion and careful historian, who set his hand to write 'in order' the things most surely believed, 'having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first.' His Gospel and Acts give us the parables of the prodigal and the good Samaritan, and the whole sweep of the early church.

characters.name: James the Just
characters.title: Brother of the Lord, Pillar at Jerusalem
characters.bio: The Lord's brother, unbelieving until the risen Christ appeared to him, who became the presiding pillar of the Jerusalem church. His plainspoken epistle — 'be ye doers of the word,' 'faith without works is dead,' 'if any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God' — helped spark the Restoration.

characters.name: Jude
characters.title: Brother of James, Contender for the Faith
characters.bio: Another brother of the Lord, who called himself simply 'the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James.' His one fierce chapter urges the saints to 'earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered' against creeping corruption.

characters.name: Onesimus
characters.title: Runaway Made a Brother Beloved
characters.bio: A slave who fled his master Philemon and found Paul — and Christ — in a Roman prison. Paul sent him home with the tenderest letter in scripture, 'not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved.'

characters.name: Felix, Festus & Agrippa
characters.title: Judges of Paul at Caesarea
characters.bio: The three rulers before whom the prisoner Paul reasoned of righteousness and resurrection — Felix trembled and delayed, Festus cried 'much learning doth make thee mad,' and King Agrippa answered, 'Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.'

groups.name: The Twelve Apostles
groups.bio: The fishermen, publicans, and zealots Jesus ordained 'that they should be with him' — sent out two by two, endowed at Pentecost, and charged to teach all nations. 'Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.'

groups.name: The Pharisees
groups.bio: The strictest sect of the Jews, keepers of the law and the traditions, whom Jesus rebuked as 'whited sepulchres' — yet from their ranks came Nicodemus, Gamaliel, and Paul himself.

groups.name: The Disciples
groups.bio: The wider circle of followers — the seventy sent without purse or scrip, the women who ministered of their substance, the five hundred who saw Him risen — first called Christians at Antioch.
